node: Travel and hospitality operating systems: property management, booking connectivity, payments, loyalty, and channel management
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the universe around hospitality operating software and integrated payments. The main underfollowed angle is that travel demand does not only monetize through hotels, OTAs, airlines, or restaurants directly; it also runs through embedded PMS, POS, booking, payment, loyalty, revenue-management, and channel-connectivity systems that are hard to replace once wired into workflows. The most relevant small/mid-cap candidates found are Agilysys, PAR Technology, and Sabre, with Shift4 included as a higher-attention reference/anchor for integrated hospitality payments. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
